rationale: Evaluating prevention of omitted required braking maneuvers requires characterising whether braking is needed and whether the vehicle initiates it. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking response itself as the subject, rather than merely a mechanism affecting another phenomenon. The hazard's failure to stop in time and FR-7.1 support including timely braking initiation. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, or failure-management mechanisms.
determining_elements: "Whether braking is required, initiated, or omitted" directly characterises the required-versus-performed braking relationship established by SG-1 and FR-7.
"In time to avoid collision" concerns the braking response itself, supported by H-1's hazardous event and FR-7.1's braking-start requirement; it does not import obstacle-detection latency into P.
The scope covers collision-relevant road users and static obstacles identified in H-1 and obstacles addressed by FR-7, while explicitly including the supplied pedestrian-crossing scenario.
